title: Catalyst customer implementation scratchpad
content:
Catalyst SE implementation scratchpad - working log and quick config notes

Context:
- Customer: Catalyst Inc (ad-tech platform) needs private deployment in us-west-2 VPC, strict data residency.
- Goal: MVP serving for real-time scoring and a reranking pipeline. 99th p latency target: 120ms for short prompts (<128 tokens).
- Delivery timeline: POC by 2024-11-15, canary rollout 2024-12-first week.

Today (2024-12-12) goals:
- Lock final quantization profile for 13B model variant.
- Validate KV cache warm-up behavior for sessions >4k tokens.
- Draft canary rollout steps + rollback triggers.

Action items (quick):
- [ ] Ethan: run perf matrix for bf16 vs int8 O2 quant on g5-16x (due 2024-12-15) - ticket SE-4128
- [ ] Marta: prepare network diagram for Catalyst VPC peering + routing to private control plane (due 2024-12-14)
- [x] Priya: initial terraform module for dedicated pool (gpu_type=g5.16x) - commit: infra/terraform#987
- [ ] Priya: write canary playbook (steps + monitoring dashboards) - draft below
- [ ] All: compile prompt set for accuracy regression test (50 sample queries, prioritize sensitive scoring cases)

Config notes / decisions so far:
- Deployment mode: Redwood Private (customer-managed VPC) with Dedicated capacity slice for production.
- GPU choice: g5.16x as baseline; fallback profile on a4 if g5 unavailable.
- Model: open-13B-v2 (quant O2 int8 recommended by Research) - tag pinned: open-13B-v2@2024-11-28
- KV cache: enable per-session prefix caching; prefer explicit cache TTL=24h for active sessions; avoid cross-session cache sharing.
- Batching: continuous batching with max_batch_tokens=4096, prefer per-route latency SLO override for reranker route (max latency 120ms).
- Autoscaler: target_util=0.68, min_replicas=2, max_replicas=12; scale-step 2 nodes.
- Fallbacks: route fallback to quantized smaller model (6B-q4) on capacity pressure >95% or if p99 latency breaches 200ms for 5m window.
- Key management: customer KMS (aws-kms://arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcde) - Redwood control plane uses customer-supplied CMK for secrets.

Canary rollout (sketch):
1) Prep
   - Provision dedicated pool with model pinned to open-13B-v2@2024-11-28 in us-west-2, backend nodes g5.16x (2 nodes).
   - Deploy monitoring: token-level cost, p50/p95/p99 latency per-route, inference errors, OOMs, GPU utilization.
2) Canary traffic (day 0-1)
   - Route 3% of production traffic (internal traffic generator) -> observe for 2 hours.
   - Checkpoint metrics: p95 < 110ms, no errors >0.1%, GPU mem headroom >= 12%
3) Ramp (day 1-3)
   - 3% -> 10% -> 30% (1h each) provided no alerts.
4) Full cutover
   - Move 100% traffic during low-traffic window; keep all autoscaler conservatively limited for 24h.
5) Rollback triggers
   - p99 latency >200ms sustained 10m OR error rate >1% OR OOMs detected -> immediate switch to fallback model and notify oncall.

Quick commands / snippets used:
- terraform apply for dedicated pool module:
  terraform apply -var \"region=us-west-2\" -target=module.catalyst_dedicated_pool
- k8s (debugging job on node):
  kubectl logs pod/redis-kvcache-0 -n redwood-private
  kubectl exec -it pod/model-server-0 -n redwood-private -- /bin/bash
- profile inference locally (dev cluster):
  ./bench_infer --model open-13B-v2 --quant O2 --batch 1 --seq 256 --device gpu --warmup 10 --iters 200

Perf observations (notes):
- Int8 O2 reduces GPU mem by ~40% on test run, throughput improves ~1.6x but p99 tail shows occasional spikes when cache miss rate >40%.
- bf16 stable latency but higher cost. For Catalyst, prefer int8 with targeted cache warmup and retry logic.

Open questions / risks:
- Data residency: customer insists on audit log retention in their S3 only — need to confirm Redwood Console log export path and retention SLA.
- KV cache eviction policy interaction with multi-session workloads (ad targeting) — possible cold-start spikes. Investigate prefetch strategies.
- Network egress: confirm private control plane communication model through NAT gateway vs VPC Peering (security team preference?).

Notes to self / todos:
- Draft short rollback runbook for SE oncall (one-pager) - include quick commands to flip routing policy to fallback model and scale down pool.
- Collect 50 golden prompts from Catalyst PM (priority: ad quality, safety edge cases) - reach out to PM Alex by EOD.
- Schedule run with infra on quota increases for g5 in target account (AWS quota request may take 3-7 days).

References / tickets:
- SE-4128: perf matrix int8 vs bf16 (Ethan)
- INFRA-772: terraform module for private dedicated pools (linked commit infra/terraform#987)
- CONFLUENCE: catalyst-private-deploy-arch (network/topology + KMS notes)

End of scratchpad (keep iterating).

-- Priya
